promotionBasis: Exact independently reviewed source/spec/SVG bytes retained. Render paths alone rebound to durable files; no geometry rerender or second substantive review.
independentSourceInventory: Three vertically stacked states of the same horizontal spring/ball/guide-rod system, each with two end supports and a left spring. Top ball lies on the common dashed vertical equilibrium line; middle ball is right of it; bottom ball is left of it.

One shared top horizontal axis, O at the equilibrium reference and X directed right. Middle state has a leftward force F, a double-ended amplitude interval and a ball-projection extension; bottom state has rightward F and a double-ended x interval.

No top-state force arrow, velocity arrows, numerical ticks or measured displacement data. Source panel letters are localized to a/b/c. The amplitude subscript glyph is not independently certified as a particular alphabet/case.

sourceFidelity.assessment: All three source states, rods, supports, spring connections, equilibrium reference, force directions and displacement endpoints are preserved. Shared-reference and b/c displacement assertions cover the points; semantic arrows have mapped connects assertions. Coil traces/support shading are explicitly schematic, not invented measured counts.
